import pyautogui
import time
import subprocess

pyautogui.PAUSE = 0.5
pyautogui.FAILSAFE = False

# Activate Chrome window
subprocess.run(["wmctrl", "-ia", "0x01200003"])
time.sleep(1)

# Click address bar (Ctrl+L) and navigate to chrome://extensions
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'l')
time.sleep(0.5)
pyautogui.typewrite('chrome://extensions', interval=0.02)
time.sleep(0.3)
pyautogui.press('enter')
time.sleep(2)

print("Navigated to chrome://extensions")
